Practice areas

Commercial, regulatory and dispute-focused legal support.

The firm publicly presents a broad practice spanning corporate transactions, litigation, ADR, employment, real estate, finance, governance, tax and specialist regulatory work.

Corporate & Commercial Law

Commercial transactions, corporate governance, contract review, business structures and regulatory compliance.

Civil & Commercial Litigation

Representation in civil and commercial disputes across Kenyan courts, including complex institutional and business matters.

Arbitration & Mediation

Arbitration, mediation and court-mandated ADR designed to resolve disputes efficiently and strategically.

Employment & Labour Relations

Employment contracts, workplace disputes, termination issues, compliance and representation in labour matters.

Property & Real Estate

Land acquisition, leasing, conveyancing, development, due diligence and property dispute resolution.

Governance, Compliance & Legal Audits

Legal and governance audits that identify risk, strengthen compliance and support institutional decision-making.
